Neither is complete without the other; together they make the cancellation protocol spec-compliant. (2 PRs)

clusters.pick_reason: The core server.py diff is byte-for-byte identical between the two PRs. The difference is in coverage pragmas: #2745 removes `# pragma: no cover` from the SSE case and changes streamable-http to `# pragma: no branch`, while #2778 preserves the original pragmas. Dropping `# pragma: no cover` from SSE is risky — if the accompanying test in #2745 does not actually exercise the SSE transport path, CI coverage checks will fail. #2778's narrower scope (only the KeyboardInterrupt fix, no pragma churn) is less likely to introduce a regression. Its title ('Suppress KeyboardInterrupt tracebacks from MCPServer.run') is also more accurate since the fix applies to all three transport cases, not just stdio.
